criteria.title: Draft v2 schema marker is represented in the domain model
criteria.assertion: SoulDraftContent exposes schema versioning constants and a schema field capable of distinguishing legacy/no-schema v1 drafts from soulfactory-draft/v2 drafts.
criteria.expected_result: v2 draft content reports soulfactory-draft/v2 while omitted schema reports soulfactory-draft/v1 for migration detection.

criteria.title: Customization nested specs round-trip
criteria.assertion: SoulDraftContent carries Persona, Avatar, Voice, and Memory fields using strongly typed nested specs with JSON tags matching the plan.
criteria.expected_result: Persona traits/system prompt sections, avatar generation/current refs, voice persona/provider settings, and memory search settings survive JSON serialization and parsing.

criteria.title: Legacy v1 fields remain migration-valid
criteria.assertion: Existing v1 fields such as avatar_prompt, assets.avatar_ref, assets.voice_ref, allowed_kinds, and tool_grants remain valid and are not dropped by migration helpers.
criteria.expected_result: MigrateToLatest returns a v2 copy that preserves legacy fields and additively seeds equivalent nested avatar/voice fields where possible.

criteria.title: Spec hash observes customization fields
criteria.assertion: Draft spec hash computation includes the new nested customization fields through canonical draft JSON serialization.
criteria.expected_result: Hashing the same v2 draft is stable, and changing a nested customization field changes the computed hash.
